verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: Scientific and health organizations worldwide have confirmed that 5G technology cannot spread viruses. COVID-19 is a respiratory illness spread through droplets from an infected person, and viruses cannot travel on radio waves or mobile networks.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming consensus of scientific bodies, international organizations, and fact-checkers have debunked the claim that 5G technology spreads the coronavirus. Sources including the NIH, the UN's International Telecommunications Union, and the Mayo Clinic state that it is scientifically impossible for viruses to travel on radio waves or mobile networks. Fact-checkers have also rated specific claims linking 5G to COVID-19 waves or geographical spread as false. There is no evidence to support the claim.
